newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: WEATHER - LIGHT SHOWERS SEEN OVER PARTS OF S.LANKA.
newsitem.headline: WEATHER - LIGHT SHOWERS SEEN OVER PARTS OF S.LANKA.

text.p: Sri Lanka's metereological department forecast scattered showers accompanied by thunder at times at a few places in the Central, Western, Sabaragamuwa and Southern provinces and in Kurunegala district for Wednesday.

It said in a statement on Tuesday that isolated thundershowers will also occur in the Uva and Eastern Provinces, while deep sea area over off the southern and western coast will experience occasional showers with gusts of fairly strong winds on Wednesday.
